title: RTPS: Dissect PID_IDENTITY_TOKEN and PID_PERMISSIONS_TOKEN security tokens
description:
PID_IDENTITY_STATUS_TOKEN (0x1006) will be removed from the DDS
Security specification. Identity and permissions updates now use
binary properties instead. Remove the corresponding dissection code
and add dissection support for the remaining security tokens:
PID_IDENTITY_TOKEN and PID_PERMISSIONS_TOKEN.

AI-Assisted: yes (GitHub Copilot)
